verse.verse_1: (The Prophet (Peace be upon him)) frowned and turned away,
verse.verse_2: Because there came to him the blind man (i.e. 'Abdullah bin Umm-Maktum, who came to the Prophet (Peace be upon him) while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs).
verse.verse_3: But what could tell you that per chance he might become pure (from sins)?
verse.verse_4: Or that he might receive admonition, and that the admonition might profit him?
verse.verse_5: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,
verse.verse_7: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief, you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allah).
verse.verse_8: But as to him who came to you running.
verse.verse_9: And is afraid (of Allah and His Punishment),
verse.verse_10: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,
verse.verse_11: Nay, (do not do like this), indeed it (these Verses of this Quran) are an admonition,
verse.verse_12: So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.
verse.verse_13: (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz).
verse.verse_17: Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is!
verse.verse_18: From what thing did He create him?
verse.verse_19: From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him, and then set him in due proportion;
verse.verse_20: Then He makes the Path easy for him;
verse.verse_21: Then He causes him to die, and puts him in his grave;
verse.verse_22: Then, when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again).
verse.verse_23: Nay, but (man) has not done what He commanded him.
verse.verse_24: Then let man look at his food,
verse.verse_25: That We pour forth water in abundance,
verse.verse_26: And We split the earth in clefts,
verse.verse_27: And We cause therein the grain to grow,
verse.verse_28: And grapes and clover plants (i.e. green fodder for the cattle),
verse.verse_30: And gardens, dense with many trees,
verse.verse_32: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_33: Then, when there comes As-Sakhkhah (the Day of Resurrection's second blowing of Trumpet),
verse.verse_34: That Day shall a man flee from his brother,
verse.verse_35: And from his mother and his father,
verse.verse_36: And from his wife and his children.
verse.verse_37: Everyman, that Day, will have enough to make him careless of others.
verse.verse_38: Some faces that Day, will be bright (true believers of Islamic Monotheism).
verse.verse_39: Laughing, rejoicing at good news (of Paradise).
verse.verse_40: And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained;
verse.verse_42: Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allah, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad (Peace be upon him), etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers).
